column1: # Pinned archives `tartci artifact-cache refresh` keeps in the host artifact
# cache that macOS gate VMs mount read-only (scripts/artifact-cache.sh).
# The url and sha256 are read from the mirror's copy of that manifest, so a
# pin bump in the repository reaches the cache at the next refresh. A line
# whose repository is not mirrored on a host is skipped there.
# Pulp gate jobs fetch the Skia archive through
# TARTCI_ARTIFACT_CACHE when present and re-verifies it. Without this line the
# blob for the current pin was never added, so every job downloaded it.
